long_description: Broadband networks generate more telemetry than any team can process. But data volume has never been the problem — and the solution goes beyond visibility. The real problem is that network performance and subscriber experience have always lived in separate worlds — and when something goes wrong, nobody can tell you fast enough whether the fault lies in your network, a content provider or pathway, or the customer's home. Aispire's mission is to bridge that chasm in real time — purpose-built for broadband, not adapted from enterprise tools. We turn your existing telemetry into content-to-subscriber Network Conversations — revealing what's happening at every point in the delivery path, classifying it by application, measuring delivery quality, and pinpointing whether degradations originate in the content layer, operator network, or in-home environment. The result: operators catch problems before subscribers feel them, and every team — from network ops to customer care — has the context they need to act. Built on patented technology born from the merger of two edge analytics and distributed data companies, Aispire's AI-powered platform serves cable, fiber, and FWA operators of any size across North America and Europe.
